title: SGLT2i delays c-Myc-induced HCC progression via targeting mTOR.
authors: Rao, Huiling; An, Xiaotong; Qu, Xinyang; Yu, Juan; Xie, Jin; Ke, Jing; Liu, Zhixin; You, Lei; Qiu, Zhenpeng; Tian, Lin; Du, Weixing; Li, Wanrong; Jia, Jie; Liu, Danwen; Li, Shan
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SGLT2抑制剂通过靶向mTOR延缓c-Myc诱导的肝癌进展，虽涉及c-Myc转录因子但核心是药物抗癌机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) stands as a primary malignant liver tumor characterized by metabolic reprogramming. The oncogene c-Myc exerts substantial influence by driving the transcription of numerous genes. Empagliflozin (EMPA), a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor (SGLT2i), is widely used in the treatment of type 2 diabetes and has recently attracted attention for its potential anti-cancer effects. This study aims to unravel the complex interplay among c-Myc, EMPA, and the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) in HCC development and progression. METHODS: HCC induction in mice utilized high-pressure hydrodynamic transfection of the c-Myc plasmid. QPCR and immunohistochemistry experiments were performed to detect the expression of SGLT2 in HCC tissues. In vivo experiments were conducted to corroborate the upregulation of SGLT2 following c-Myc transfection. In invo and vitro investigations were conducted to evaluate the anti-cancer effects of two SGLT2i: EMPA and canagliflozin (CANA). Network pharmacology, molecular docking analyses, CETSA experiments, and additional western blot experiments were used to reveal EMPA's interaction inhibition with mTOR. RESULTS: The study identified an increase in SGLT2 expression in HCC tissues as a result of c-Myc overexpression. In vitro experiments confirmed the upregulation of SGLT2 following c-Myc transfection. Notably, the administration of SGLT2i effectively curtailed liver cancer progression, and reduced hepatic fat accumulation in mice. EMPA exhibited significant suppression of cell proliferation in c-Myc-transfected cells. In vitro experiments unveiled EMPA's interaction and with inhibition the activation of mTOR. CONCLUSION: Our study highlights EMPA's potential as a therapeutic agent in delaying the development and progression of HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（HCC）是一种以代谢重编程为特征的原发性恶性肝肿瘤。癌基因c-Myc通过驱动众多基因的转录发挥重要影响。恩格列净（EMPA）是一种钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2i），广泛用于2型糖尿病的治疗，近年来因其潜在的抗癌作用而受到关注。本研究旨在揭示c-Myc、EMPA和哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白（mTOR）在HCC发生发展中的复杂相互作用。方法：通过高压流体动力学转染c-Myc质粒诱导小鼠HCC。采用QPCR和免疫组化实验检测HCC组织中SGLT2的表达。进行体内实验以证实c-Myc转染后SGLT2的上调。通过体内和体外研究评估两种SGLT2i（EMPA和卡格列净（CANA））的抗癌效果。利用网络药理学、分子对接分析、CETSA实验及额外的western blot实验揭示EMPA与mTOR的相互作用抑制。结果：研究发现，c-Myc过表达导致HCC组织中SGLT2表达增加。体外实验证实c-Myc转染后SGLT2上调。值得注意的是，SGLT2i的给药有效抑制了肝癌进展，并减少了小鼠肝脏脂肪积累。EMPA在c-Myc转染细胞中显著抑制细胞增殖。体外实验揭示EMPA与mTOR相互作用并抑制其激活。结论：我们的研究强调EMPA作为延缓HCC发生和进展的治疗药物的潜力。
